name: JV Login Design Styler Lite
author: Jeet Vaja

sections.description:
JV Login Design Styler Lite lets you personalize your WordPress login page in just a few clicks.
Change the logo, background color, and button color — all from a simple settings panel.

Features:

✅ Upload / set a custom logo
✅ Set login page background color
✅ Change login button color
✅ Lightweight – no builder, no bloat
✅ Live preview–friendly styling
✅ No coding required

Perfect for bloggers, developers, and agencies who want a branded login page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/jv-login-design-styler-lite/ directory, or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Login Styler in the WordPress admin.
  4. Adjust your login page settings.
sections.faq:
Does this affect website speed?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads styling on the login page.

Can I customize fonts or templates?

Not in the Lite version. These features will be included in the Pro version.

Will it work with all themes?

Yes, it works with any WordPress theme.
